steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enter the awarding screen so the proposal can be created.
Allocate the available line item to the vendor named by the case; the exact 10-item allocation is not available in the prepared state.
Create the award proposal from the awarding screen.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Verify the Document tab content or control is present.
Verify the Overview tab content or control is present.
Verify the Allocation Summary tab is shown; the requested vendor and quantity details are not asserted because the prepared state differs.
Verify the comparison view references the Master QCS.
Verify the Participants tab is shown; the requested complete multi-vendor non-bidder list is not available in this state.
Verify the Order Allocation tab is shown.
